title: [UI][Checkout] Overview totals are calculated correctly
precondition: Standard user is logged in on the Products page with an empty cart.
gherkin:
Given my cart holds "Sauce Labs Backpack" ($29.99) and "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" ($49.99)
When I reach the checkout overview
Then Item total is $79.98, Tax is $6.40 and Total is $86.38

steps.action: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" to the cart
Go through Checkout with valid information to the Overview page
steps.expected: Overview lists both products with prices $29.99 and $49.99
Item total equals the sum of item prices: $79.98
Tax is 8% of item total rounded to cents: $6.40
